subject.title: [Feature]: Harden native i18n extraction and locale validation

question: Which translation-quality findings should become hard CI failures in the first native i18n hardening change?
rationale: Extractor completeness and artifact-contract parity are objective, but source-equal and duplicated-word findings require maintainer-owned false-positive, allowlist, and enforcement policy.

options.title: Objective failures, advisory heuristics
options.body: Fail extraction, inventory, metadata, uniqueness, and structural-token drift while reporting source-equal and duplicated-word findings for calibration.

options.title: Also fail source contradictions
options.body: Hard-fail source-equal cells that contradict an existing translation using a reviewed allowlist, while leaving duplicate-word findings advisory.

options.title: Fail every proposed check
options.body: Make both heuristic classes blocking after comprehensive locale-specific allowlists are reviewed and committed.

recommendation.title: Objective failures, advisory heuristics
recommendation.body: Fail extraction, inventory, metadata, uniqueness, and structural-token drift while reporting source-equal and duplicated-word findings for calibration.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history shows steipete introduced and most recently maintained the complete native i18n pipeline and its publication workflow.
